title: 第12章 觉醒向导后必须明白的事-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙都想骂他了！

    男人却像是非要把控住对话的节奏那样，还是对她爱答不理的。

    直到秦夙再次张嘴，“你简直……”

    “我叫魏知弦，离颂小队的副队长。”他打断了秦夙的话，“也是有医生资质的队医。正因为如此，我才被离队留下来照看你。但你好像并不领情？”

    “好像好像！”秦夙真被这个家伙阴阳怪气的腔调给惹毛了，“我好像很关心离队长，我好像还很多此一举，我好像不领你的情，我好像还发育了什么腺体。腺体到底是个什么东西你倒是给我说明白啊！”

    她炸毛了，魏知弦顿了顿，却依然不为所动。

    从旁边拿起一本画册，放到了秦夙手边，“你身上发生的事，可以从这上面寻找答案。”

    他则拿起另一本很厚的书，坐在窗边的沙发里去了。

    秦夙抓起画册运了好几口气。

    魏知弦听到她粗重的呼吸，手指在自己的书上摩挲两下。

    语气变得柔和了一些，“你右手边床头柜上有蛋糕和奶茶，是谢尘无跟随离队出任务之前给你准备的，现在你一定很饿，吃不饱的话，再过一个半小时，会有护士来送病号餐。”

    谢尘无执行任务去了？就是说，他没被关禁闭咯？太好了！

    这时秦夙肚子咕噜一声，确实饿的前胸贴后背。

    边看书边吃吧。

    左手拿过画册，看看封面。

    印刷了Q版的白衣向导形象，书名：《觉醒向导后，你必须明白的100件事》。

    “为什么这么低龄啊？”她郁闷的再用右手取抓起一个老式鸡蛋糕，咬一口嚼嚼嚼，“好像是给小朋友看的小人儿书。”

    “你现在的知识储备水平，跟小朋友没什么区别。”

    秦夙无语。

    看在鸡蛋糕虽然朴实无华，却实在很香甜的份上。

    想着这可是尘尘小老师准备……

    “等等。”她再咬一口蛋糕，转头看向魏知弦，“谢尘无跟离队长一起出任务去了？”

    “昏迷太久，刚醒来是会有些迟钝。”魏知弦从黑色作战服口袋里掏出一副无框眼镜戴上了，“不用为此感到困惑，过几个小时就会好起来的。”

    秦夙吐槽，“又不好好回答问题。”

    魏知弦：“一开始问你的问题，你不是也没回答我。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Su almost wanted to scold him!

The man, however, seemed to insist on controlling the rhythm of the conversation, and still ignored her.

Until Qin Su opened his mouth again, "You are simply..."

"My name is Wei Zhixian, the deputy captain of the Lisong team." He interrupted Qin Su, "I am also a team doctor with medical qualifications. Because of this, I was left to look after you. But you don't seem to appreciate it?"

"It seems like it!" Qin Suzhen was offended by this guy's sinister tone. "I seem to care about Captain Li very much. I seem to do a lot of things. I don't seem to appreciate your kindness. I seem to have developed some glands. You should explain to me clearly what a gland is!"

She was furious, Wei Zhixian paused, but remained unmoved.

He picked up a picture album from the side and put it in Qin Su's hand, "You can find the answer to what happened to you from this."

He picked up another thick book and sat on the sofa by the window.

Qin Su grabbed the picture album and took a few breaths.

Wei Zhixian heard her heavy breathing and rubbed his fingers twice on his book.

The tone became softer, "There are cakes and milk tea on the bedside table on your right. Xie Chenwu prepared them for you before he left the team to go on a mission. You must be very hungry now. If you are not full, a nurse will come to deliver sick meals in another hour and a half."

Xie Chenwu went on a mission?That is to say, he was not imprisoned?Very good!

At this time, Qin Su's stomach growled, and he was really hungry, his chest pressed against his back.

Let’s eat while reading.

He took the album with his left hand and looked at the cover.

Printed the Q version of the image of the guide in white, with the book title: "100 Things You Must Understand After Awakening as a Guide".

"Why are you so young?" She depressedly picked up an old-fashioned chicken cake with her right hand, took a bite and chewed it, "It seems to be a little book for children."

"Your current knowledge level is no different from that of a child."

Qin Su was speechless.

though the chicken cake is plain and simple, is actually very sweet.

Thinking that this is what little teacher Chenchen is preparing...

"Wait a minute." She took another bite of the cake and turned to look at Wei Zhixian, "Xie Chenwu went on a mission with Captain Li?"

"You will be a little sluggish when you wake up after being comatose for too long." Wei Zhixian took out a pair of rimless glasses from the pocket of his black combat uniform and put them on, "Don't be confused about this, you will be fine in a few hours."

Qin Su complained, "I don't answer questions well."

Wei Zhixian: "You didn't answer my question when I asked you at the beginning."
